prompt: Complete two reviewer-owned unfamiliar technology-strategy and migration exercises at materially different portfolio scales. After the first review, the reviewer changes at least one hidden hard constraint, one evidence-confidence assumption and one delivery or financial input. Produce independent evidence without published model answers, employer data or production access.

Versioned portfolio inventory distinguishing observed declared inferred and unknown evidence
Criticality business-cycle contract lifecycle and dependency-group map
Current-state cost capacity risk support and performance baseline with semantic definitions
Workload rationalization across credible retain retire move buy and modernize strategies
Target-state architecture principles standards interoperability and time-bounded exception process
Decision-rights responsibility governance cadence risk and evidence model
Three-year or reviewer-defined capacity calculation with growth headroom failure reserve and sensitivity
Data-transfer synchronization validation and cutover calculation with uncertainty
Comparable current target transition opportunity and exit cost model with range and break-even
Vendor scorecard with hard vetoes supplier security portability data export concentration and exit evidence
Foundation readiness covering identity network security logging quotas automation and operations
Pilot and dependency-aware wave plan bounded by team and platform capacity
Coexistence compatibility writer authority fencing synchronization and lag design
Go-no-go stop rollback-feasibility forward-recovery and business-reconciliation plan
Operational handover benefit realization retention and decommission evidence
Architecture strategy decision record with alternatives consequences residual risks and supersession
Executive investment engineering migration and operations narratives
Revised strategy showing how hidden changed constraints invalidate or preserve earlier decisions
evidenceRequirements: Use reviewer-owned sanitized fictional or disposable evidence only
No employer inventory contracts prices architecture credentials endpoints customer data or production mutation
Every portfolio fact identifies source observation window confidence owner and review date
Unknown evidence cannot be scored as low risk or treated as absent
Every numerical result includes units semantics formula range assumptions and sensitivity
Hard security legal residency correctness and exit constraints are applied before weighted preferences
Migration strategy is selected per workload or dependency group rather than mandated uniformly
Dependency evidence includes technical data owner validation business cycles and known sampling gaps
Waves preserve dependency groups and do not exceed delivery platform or support capacity
Coexistence defines compatible versions one writer authority fencing and reconciliation
Rollback distinguishes traffic reversal from state and external-effect recovery
Financial comparison includes transition opportunity support risk and exit costs without fabricated savings
Vendor claims require attributable evidence and contractual or tested acceptance where appropriate
Success includes user data security reliability operations cost and decommission outcomes
Reviewer controls hidden changes scoring follow-up defense and cleanup proof
